local: In plenty and in time of need
When this fair land was young
Our brave forefathers sowed the seed
From which our pride is sprung
english: In plenty and in time of need
When this fair land was young
Our brave forefathers sowed the seed
From which our pride is sprung

local: A pride that makes no wanton boast
Of what it has withstood
That binds our hearts from coast to coast
The pride of nationhood
english: A pride that makes no wanton boast
Of what it has withstood
That binds our hearts from coast to coast
The pride of nationhood

local: We loyal sons and daughters all
Do hereby make it known
These fields and hills beyond recall
Are now our very own
english: We loyal sons and daughters all
Do hereby make it known
These fields and hills beyond recall
Are now our very own

local: We write our names on history's page
With expectations great
Strict guardians of our heritage
Firm craftsmen of our fate
english: We write our names on history's page
With expectations great
Strict guardians of our heritage
Firm craftsmen of our fate

local: The Lord has been the people's guide
For past three hundred years.
With Him still on the people's side
We have no doubts or fears.
english: The Lord has been the people's guide
For past three hundred years.
With Him still on the people's side
We have no doubts or fears.

local: Upward and onward we shall go,
Inspired, exulting, free,
And greater will our nation grow
In strength and unity.
english: Upward and onward we shall go,
Inspired, exulting, free,
And greater will our nation grow
In strength and unity.
